newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-J.P. Morgan raises Email stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-J.P. Morgan raises Email stake.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Investment Management Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it had increased its stake in appliance manufacturer Email Ltd to 6.81 percent from 5.79.

J.P. Morgan said in a substantial shareholder notice to the Australian Stock Exchange that it had bought 3.38 million Email shares between late November and early October, taking its stake to 19.8 million shares.
Email said earlier this week it did not know why its share price had risen sharply early this week.
Email shares were down six cents at A$3.54 at 12.50 p.m. (0250 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
